recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-47241 unless OO later chooses to open a separate editorial grammar cleanup.
issue_request: FHIR-47241 was an Applied FHIR-core NutritionProduct change request for R6. The reporter noted that the boolean NutritionProduct.ingredient.allergen description sounded like a list of substances. OO resolved it as Not Persuasive with Modification: keep the element boolean, but change the description to wording for a known or suspected allergenic and/or substance associated with intolerance.
initial_application: Jira-tagged commit d0f9f0cb921ca73af9137792711cb1d73df8e5c1 updated source/nutritionproduct/structuredefinition-NutritionProduct.xml, replacing the old list-like allergen short and definition with singular boolean-oriented wording. Git blame shows that commit owns the current NutritionProduct.ingredient.allergen short and definition.
additional_context: NutritionProduct is active in source/fhir.ini, and NutritionProduct.ingredient.allergen is listed in the active per-element configuration. OO Nutrition minutes show the issue awaiting additional guidance on 2024-10-23 and voted 9-0-0 on 2024-11-20. Jira search found no separate related allergen issue, and Zulip/Confluence full-text searches found no conflicting later community discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active StructureDefinition says the allergen element is boolean and defines it as "A known or suspected allergenic and/or substance that is associated with an intolerance," which satisfies the applied decision by no longer describing a list of substances.
